record.title: microduck-eye-ring — the eye bezel, REBUILT parametrically from calipers (ours)
record.why: REBUILT AND GRADED, 2026-09-05. cad/part.py is a SOLID OF REVOLUTION generated from ten caliper readings plus three locating tabs; it no longer loads Pollen's mesh. ce-cad/bin/cad-refcheck part:microduck-eye-ring --ref reference/pollen-microduck-rl/assets/noenoeil.stl --evidence: p95 surface distance 0.0109 mm reference->ours and 0.0109 mm ours->reference (median 0.0009, max 0.0140, 100.0 % of 6000 samples inside 1.0 mm both ways); bbox ours 29.991 x 9.500 x 30.000 against the reference's 30.000 x 9.500 x 30.000, delta -0.009 / 0.000 / 0.000 mm; 2 of 2 reference features matched (the Ø14.400 x 6.000 bore and the Ø30.000 x 7.500 outer boss), 0 unmatched, 0 extra. PASS on all three legs of docs/REBUILD-PROTOCOL.md, in ONE round. Evidence iterations/v0.0.1/evidence/refcheck/2026-09-04T19-21-10Z/. BUILT SOLID, MEASURED off the finished shape (ce-cad/bin/cad part:microduck-eye-ring): Compound, 1 solid, 1 shell, 87 faces, valid=True, volume 4255.615 mm3, bbox 30.000 x 9.500 x 30.000 mm. Exported STL geometry/eye-ring.stl WATERTIGHT — 2076 triangles, 0 open edges, 0 non-manifold edges, 0 misoriented edges, 0 degenerate facets, signed volume 4254.1 mm3 (tools/stlcheck.py, out/own/stlcheck/eye-ring.json). STILL OPEN and NOT settled by this rebuild: the ring's true OD on the PRODUCT. The photogrammetry rows below stand — solving ring OD and head width together off the front view gives 31.239 +- 1.065 mm against the 30.000 modelled here, CANNOT DETERMINE at the 1.5 mm rule, and a calliper across one product ring settles it. This part is graded against the published MESH, which is what the licence lane needs; it is not a claim about the retail part's diameter.
record.origin_why: OURS. Authored 2026-09-05 by the own-geometry lane as a parametric solid of revolution. It REPLACES a loader that shipped Pollen Robotics' noenoeil.stl (CC BY-SA-NC) as this folder's geometry; that STL has been deleted from the folder and the loader's ledger row is kept above so the change is auditable. No vertex, facet or decimated outline of Pollen's mesh survives in cad/part.py.

record.source_reference: reference/pollen-microduck-rl/assets/noenoeil.stl — MEASUREMENT SUBJECT and refcheck reference only; no geometry is taken from it
record.why_this_folder_exists: spec/mesh-to-part.json maps noenoeil here; created empty 2026-09-01, filled with a vendor-mesh loader 2026-09-03 (lane A), and REBUILT AS OURS 2026-09-05 (own-geometry lane) so the head group stops blocking sale on provenance.
record.how_the_geometry_was_authored: CALIPERS ON A PUBLISHED ARTIFACT, then a parametric revolve — ordinary reverse engineering, not copying. tools/own_measure_eyering.py ray-casts the published mesh at 0.1 mm pitch along two orthogonal probe lines and freezes the readings in out/own/measure/eye-ring.json; the result is a LIST OF DIMENSIONS, not geometry. cad/part.py quotes ten of them by probe line in its docstring — OD 30.000 (probe A, outer radius 15.000 flat over y -63.0..-55.5), bore 14.400 (probe A, inner radius 7.200 over y -61.5..-55.5), front face y -63.500 and rear face y -55.500 (probe C), a 0.500 x 45 deg front chamfer and a 2.000 mm 45 deg bore funnel (both read as a 2.000 mm rise over 2.000 mm of radius), and three 20 deg locating tabs 120 deg apart between r 8.500 and 9.500 reaching y -54.000 (section at y -54.75) — and generates the part by revolving a six-point (r, y) profile about the optical axis and adding three annular-sector prisms. Every driving number is a fit dimension: the bore is clearance for part:microduck-m12-lens' barrel, the rear face butts on part:microduck-face-part's front plane y -55.500, and the tabs enter that panel to locate the bezel on the optical axis.
record.licence_position: OURS TO SELL. The expression here is a parametric revolve authored in this repo from measured dimensions and from the interfaces the bezel must satisfy; dimensions taken off a published artifact are facts and are not protected by the CC BY-SA-NC grant on Pollen's model files (reference/pollen-microduck-rl/microduck_rl_README.md:196). The vendor STL that used to sit in geometry/ is deleted, so nothing under CC BY-SA-NC ships in this folder. The reference mesh is still cited as the MEASUREMENT SUBJECT and as the refcheck reference, which is a citation, not a derivation. Reviewed against docs/REBUILD-PROTOCOL.md; recorded for LICENCE-POSITION.html.
